BT10-046.title: BT10-046 Vegito, Infinite Radiance

BT10-053.text: Q1. If you use this card's [Permanent] skill to activate [Union-Potara] and play this card on top of {BT7-042 Goku Black, the Replicator} in your energy, does {BT7-042 Goku Black, the Replicator}'s [Auto] skill activate? A1. No, it doesn't.

BT10-092.title: BT10-092 SS Gotenks, Display of Mastery
BT10-092.text: Q1. When your opponent uses the [Activate : Main] skill of {BT9-109 Emperor's Death Beam} in their Drop Area, does this card's auto skill activate? A1. No, it doesn't. The [Activate : Main] skill of {BT9-109 Emperor's Death Beam} doesn't count as activating an Extra Card. Q2. Your opponent uses｛SD7-01 Miraculous Arrival Shenron｝’s activate skill to activate an Extra Card in their hand. Does this card’s auto skill activate? A3. Yes, it does.

BT12-136.text: Q1. When you activate this card’s [Union-Fusion] skill, can you choose 1 card each from your hand and Warp? A1. Yes, you can.

BT12-137.text: Q1. When you activate this card’s [Union-Fusion] skill, can you choose 1 card each from your hand and Warp? A1. Yes, you can.

BT14-094.text: Q1. If you use [Spirit Boost] to remove all of this card’s markers and place it in its owner’s Drop Area, does this card’s auto skill activate? A1. Yes, it does.

BT16-142.title: BT16-142 SS Gogeta, Holding Nothing Back
BT16-142.text: Q1. This card is placed in your Drop Area the same turn you played it. At the end of the turn, can you use this card’s [Auto] skill to draw 1 card and add up to 1 Red/Blue multicolor card from your Drop Area to your energy? A1. No, you can’t.

BT18-001.title: BT18-001 SS4 Son Goku & SS4 Vegeta, In It Together
BT18-001.text: Q1. What actions can your opponent no longer perform with the "your opponent skips their Defense Step" part of this card's second [Permanent] skill? A1. Your opponent can no longer perform combos or activate skills such as [Activate : Battle] or [Activate : Main/Battle].

BT18-019.text: Q1. BT18-085.title: BT18-085 SS Son Goten & SS Trunks, Unfurled Potential
BT18-085.text: Q1. If you use this card's [Activate : Battle] to combo with this card in your Drop, after the battle is over, can you choose to add this card to your Z-Energy before sending it to your Warp? A1. Yes, you can.

BT19-085.title: BT19-085 SS Gogeta, Facing the Ultimate
BT19-085.text: Q1. You activated this card's [Union-Fusion]. Can you use this card's [Permanent] skill to choose 1 of the specified cards from your Z-Energy and 1 from your hand? A1. Yes, you can.

BT2-013.title: BT2-013 Lightning Speed Vegito
BT2-013.text: Q1. You use [Union-Potara] to play a card on top of a card that received +5000 power and [Double Strike] for the duration of the turn. Do these power boosts and skills transfer to the new card? A1. The new card retains the +5000 power boost, but does not receive [Double Strike]. When playing cards on top of other cards, only changes to power transfer. Any skills granted to the cards placed below do not. Q2. Can you attack your own Battle Cards in Active Mode? A2. No, you cannot. Q3. Can you evolve into {BT2-012 Repeated Force Vegito} with {BT2-013 Lightning Speed Vegito}’s skill? A3. Yes, you can. {BT2-012 Repeated Force Vegito} has 25000 power, and its character name is "Vegito," so the specified conditions are fulfilled. Q4. Do you need to pay the energy cost or [Evolve] cost for cards evolved via card skills? A4. No, you do not need to pay the unless specified otherwise. Q5. If this card attacks a Battle Card with [Revenge], does its auto skill activate at the end of the battle? A5. Yes, it does.

BT2-015.title: BT2-015 Prodigy Fusion Super Saiyan Gotenks
BT2-015.text: Q1. Can you activate [Union-Fusion] with {BT2-008 Leap to The Future Son Goten} and {BT2-011 Leap to The Future Trunks}? A1. Yes, you can. The character name of {BT2-008 Leap to The Future Son Goten} and {BT2-011 Leap to The Future Trunks} is “Son Goten” and “Trunks: Youth,” and they both have the same power, so the condition specified on the card text is fulfilled. Please check the details on the ERRATA CARDS section of the RULE page of our official web site.

BT2-058.title: BT2-058 Infinite Force Fused Zamasu
BT2-058.text: Q1. You use [Union-Potara] to play a card on top of a card that received +5000 power and [Double Strike] for the duration of the turn. Do these power boosts and skills transfer to the new card? A1. The new card retains the +5000 power boost, but does not receive [Double Strike]. When playing cards on top of other cards, only changes to power transfer. Any skills granted to the cards placed below do not. Q2. When placing your energy and life and hand at the bottom of your deck due to your opponent’s｛BT2-058 Infinite Force Fused Zamasu｝’s auto skill, which player chooses the cards? A2. The opponent does. Q3. When placing your energy and life and hand at the bottom of your deck due to your opponent’s｛BT2-058 Infinite Force Fused Zamasu｝’s auto skill, can the opponent place the card at the bottom of your deck in any order? A3. Yes, they can. Q4. When choosing cards from your opponent’s life and hand with｛BT2-058 Infinite Force Fused Zamasu｝’s auto skill, do you choose the cards without looking at their contents? A4. Yes, you do. Q5. Can you choose cards only from your opponent’s energy and hand with｛BT2-058 Infinite Force Fused Zamasu｝’s auto skill? A5. Yes, you can. Q6. Can you choose a Battle Card with [Indestructible] as the target of｛BT1-065 Furious Yell Vegeta｝’s activate skill? A6. Yes, you can. In this case, the Battle Card with [Indestructible] is not KO-ed. Q7. Can you combo with a Battle Card in the Battle Area which has [Indestructible]? A7. Yes, you can. Q8. If you choose a Battle Card which has [Indestructible] with the opponents {BT1-057 Broly, The Legendary Super Saiyan}’s auto skill, is it placed in the Drop Area? A8. No, it is not. Cards with [Indestructible do not leave the Battle Area due to your opponent’s skills. Q9. If you choose a Battle Card which has [Indestructible] with your {BT1-057 Broly, The Legendary Super Saiyan}’s auto skill, is it placed in the Drop Area? A9. Yes, it is. [Indestructible] is a skill which prevents a card from being KO-ed or removed from the Battle Area due to opponent Effects, but not your own. Q10. Can you use a skill that gains control of an opponent’s Battle Card to gain control of an opponent’s Battle Card with [Indestructible]? A10. No, you can’t. Q11. If your Battle Card with [Indestructible] has its power lowered to 0 or less by an opponent’s skill, is it placed in your Drop Area? A11. Yes, it is placed in your Drop Area. Skills like [Indestructible] prevent cards from being removed from your Battle Area, but they still get placed in your Drop Area when an opponent’s skill reduces their power to zero or less. After you check to see if a card would be placed in the Drop Area by a skill, you then check to see if the card would be placed there by rules processing. The reason this is possible is because, in this instance, rules processing is what places cards in the Drop Area, not the skill itself.

BT2-085.title: BT2-085 Evolving Evil Lifeform Cell
BT2-085.text: Q1. How are the cards under this card treated? A1. The cards are treated as the same card as the card on top of them, and the whole stack counts as 1 card. Q2. When the cards under this card are place in the Drop Area, from where did they supposedly move from? A2. From whatever area the card on top of them was in. Q3. Can you activate the skills of cards placed under this card? A3. No, you cannot. all information on the cards placed under this card is negated. Q4. Can you place {BT2-090 Exterminating Energy Android 18} under ｛BT2-085 Evolving Evil Lifeform Cell｝ as the cost of [Union-Absorb]? A4. Yes, you can. The character name of {BT2-090 Exterminating Energy Android 18} is “Android 18” so the condition specified on the card text is fulfilled. Q5. Can you play ｛BT2-085 Evolving Evil Lifeform Cell｝ on ｛BT2-085 Evolving Evil Lifeform Cell｝ from your deck with [Union-Absorb]? A5. Yes, you can. Q6. Can You choose not to draw a card with {BT2-085 Evolving Evil Lifeform Cell}’s auto skill? A6. No, you cannot. You must draw 1 card.

The attack of a card with [Triple Attack] was negated. Can it be switched to Active Mode with [Triple Attack]? A3. Yes, it can. Even if the attack is negated, skills which are processed at the end of a battle are resolved, and thus you can switch the card to Active Mode. Q4. Can you include a total of 2 or more cards with [Ultimate] in your deck if they’re split between your deck and side deck? A4. No, you can’t. You can only include a total of 1 card with [Ultimate] combined between your deck and side deck.

BT22-137.text: Q1. If this card's power is reduced to zero by an opponent's skill when it can't be removed from your Battle Area, is it placed in your Drop? A1. Yes, it is.

BT22-140.text: Q1. If you activate this card's [Aegis] skill when the [Permanent] skill is active, which player chooses the card to send from your opponent’s hand to the bottom of their deck? A1. The master of this card places 1 card from the hand of their opponent at the bottom of their deck.

BT25-036.text: Q1. What happens if a non-blue Z-Extra is placed into your Battle Area when there are already multiple blue Z-Extras in your Battle Area? A1. All of the existing blue Z-Extras are removed from the game, and the non-blue Z-Extra is placed into the Battle Area.

BT5-068.text: Q1. After you use this card’s activated skill to look through your deck, can you choose a 〈Super 17〉 with an energy cost of 6 from your Drop Area? A1. Yes, you can.

BT6-013.title: BT6-013 Veku, the Fragile
BT6-013.text: Q1. What happens to Battle Cards that reach zero power or below as a result of effects that reduce power? A1. Battle Cards that drop to zero power are placed in their owner's Drop Area.

BT6-015.title: BT6-015 Gogeta, Unparalleled Fusion Warrior
BT6-015.text: Q1. What does “this card can't be KO'd” mean? A1. It means the card can’t be KO’d by battle or by skills. Q2. If you don’t have 1 or more red ＜Son Goku: Br＞ and ＜Vegeta: Br＞ cards in your hand, can you activate this card’s [Union-Fusion]? A2. No, you can’t. [Union-Fusion]’s skill cost requires you to place 1 copy of each of the specified cards with the same power in their owner’s Drop Area. If you don’t pay this cost, you can’t activate the skill.

BT7-118.title: BT7-118 Meteoric Energy SSB Vegito
BT7-118.text: Q1. You used this card’s auto skill to choose your opponent’s cards in Rest Mode. During your opponent’s next Charge Phase, can they switch those cards to Active Mode? A1. No, they can’t. Q2. Can I combo with cards from my hand during my Offense Step in order to fulfill this card's second auto ability? A2. No, you may not. You must have a minimum of 3 battle cards in your combo area by the time the second auto ability resolves, which would be before the Offense Step.

BT8-017.title: BT8-017 Baby, Vengeful Blow
BT8-017.text: Q1. When {BT2-064 Mafuba} is on top of this card, you played a separate copy of {BT3-077 Evil Psyche Zamasu}. Afterwards, the {BT2-064 Mafuba} is placed in the Drop Area. You now have 2 copies of {BT3-077 Evil Psyche, Zamasu} in your Battle Area. What happens? A1. You choose 1 of the copies to leave in your Battle Area, then place the other copy in its owner’s Drop Area.

EX01-07.text: Q1. When activating {EX01-07 Psyched Up Gotenks}’s [Union-Fusion], can you play it by placing {BT2-008 Leap to the Future Son Goten} and {BT2-011 Leap to the Future Trunks} in the Drop Area from your hand? A1. Yes, you can. {BT2-008 Leap to the Future Son Goten} and {BT2-011 Leap to the Future Trunks} have the character names “Son Goten” and “Trunks: Youth” respectively, and both have the same power, so the conditions specified on the card text are fulfilled. Can you use {EX01-07 Psyched Up Gotenks}’s auto skill to draw 2 cards and KO an opponent’s battle card? A2. Yes, you can. When {EX01-07 Psyched Up Gotenks}’s auto skill activates, both ＜Son Goten＞ and ＜Trunks: Youth＞ are in your Drop Area as a result of [Union-Fusion], so both conditions on the card text are fulfilled. Q3. You have ＜Trunks: Youth＞ in your Drop Area, but not ＜Son Goten＞. Can you KO an opponent’s Battle Card when {EX01-07 Psyched Up Gotenks} enters play? A3. Yes, you can. Resolve as many parts of the skill as you can.

EX06-19.text: Q1. Can you activate this card's [Union-Absorb] skill by placing {EX06-20 Android Troop - 14 & 15} under this card? A1. No, you can't. The card requires that you place two cards under it to activate [Union-Absorb]: one 〈Android 14〉 card and one 〈Android 15〉 card.

EX14-04.title: EX14-04 SS Son Goten & Trunks, Super Saiyan Tag Team
EX14-04.text: Q1. Can you discard 1 copy of this card to activate {BT10-110 Gotenks, Going All-Out}’s [Union-Fusion] skill? A1. No, you can’t. You must discard 1 ＜Son Goten : GT＞ card and 1 ＜Trunks : GT＞ card in order to activate that skill.

P-185.title: P-185 Kefla, Everlasting Light
P-185.text: Q1. If this card has its power reduced to zero or below by a skill that says “gets -X power for the duration of the turn” how is this card’s permanent skill applied? A1. First, this card’s owner can choose to use “you may choose 1 multicolor card from your hand and place it in your Drop Area instead”. If they choose not to place a card in their Drop Area, this card is sent to the Drop Area. If they choose to place a card in their Drop Area, it prevents the card from being placed in the Drop Area once, but since effects that decrease power are continuous effects, the power reduction would remain and this card would be placed in the Drop Area due to the rules.

P-220.title: P-220 SSB Vegito, Soaring Blow
P-220.text: Q1. If you use this card's [Permanent] skill to activate [Union-Potara] and play this card on top of {BT1-033 Kind Saiyan Son Goku} in your energy, does {BT1-033 Kind Saiyan Son Goku}'s [Auto] skill activate? A1. No, it doesn't.

P-230.title: P-230 SS Vegeks, Mastery Merged
P-230.text: Q1. If you use this card's [Permanent] skill to activate [Union-Potara] and play this card on top of a {Vegeta, Returned from Darkness} in your energy, does {Vegeta, Returned from Darkness}'s [Auto] skill activate? A1. No, it doesn't. Q2. Your opponent activates the [Counter : Play] skill on {BT10-044 SS Trunks, God-Sealing Technique} in response to this card’s [Union-Potara] skill, causing you to return this card to your hand instead of playing it. Can you play the ＜Trunks : Xeno＞ and ＜Vegeta : Xeno＞ cards you sent to your Warp with this card’s [Union-Potara] skill? A2. No, you can’t.

P-286.title: P-286 SS3 Gogeta, Martial Melee
P-286.text: Q1. When you activate this card’s [Union-Fusion] skill, can you choose 1 card each from your hand and Warp? A1. Yes, you can.

SD6-04.title: SD6-04 Ultimate Fusion Gogeta
SD6-04.text: Q1. When using this card’s auto skill to place an opponent’s Battle Card on the bottom of its owner’s deck, who decides which order the Battle Cards get returned to the bottom of their owners’ decks in? A1. The player who activated this card’s auto skill chooses.

TB3-054.title: TB3-054 Piccolo, Potential Unleashed
TB3-054.text: Q1. Can you choose a yellow 《Namekian》 card with an energy cost of 4 from your Drop Area after looking at your deck with this card’s Activate : Main skill? A1. Yes, you can. However, make sure to resolve the skill as quickly as possible, and do not look at other cards unless absolutely necessary.
